'I´ll take the leader - AO' is posted under Effects; the card is the Admiral's Order I'll Take The Leader.

The strategy's later update (after Tatooine's release) says to take out 1 Ralltiir Freighter Captain for Yotta (Yotta Oren 'or whatever his name is') and Old Ben for Menace Fades, and that 'the deck went 10-0 at Ramapo'; the post does not say who played it there. The list here is the April 2001 list as posted.
The strategy describes the final game 'of nationals' against Martin Falke (Jabba the Hutt and Jodo Kast in the Audience Chamber) and calls the title an inside joke from 'the regional'.
